title: 공군방공관제사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Duties of the Commander, etc.)
(1) Under the orders of the Commander of the Air Force Operations Command, the Commander shall exercise overall control over the affairs of the Command and direct and supervise units organically subordinated to or attached to the Command.
(2) The Deputy Commander shall assist the Commander and act on the Commander's behalf where the Commander is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances.
(3) The Chief of Staff shall assist the Commander and, under the Commander's orders, coordinate and control staff duties.
